top_story: Fighting in Yemen has intensified into the clearest immediate humanitarian emergency, with hospitals in Taiz buckling under mass casualties as shortages of food, water, and medical care deepen civilian suffering. The guilty plea in Colorado by an Egyptian man who fire-bombed a pro-Israel rally underscores how Middle East conflict is also feeding violent polarization far beyond the region, making civilian vulnerability the common thread across these developments.
